states.label: CURRENT
states.definition: The successful Run matches the active effective planning input using existing identity, invalidation, and comparable fingerprint evidence.
states.colorIndependentCue: Visible CURRENT text plus Scenario/Version and Run source.

states.label: STALE
states.definition: A known result Run remains available as source evidence, while an RF- or optimization-affecting edit or incompatible source identity means it does not describe the active effective input.
states.colorIndependentCue: Visible STALE text, original Version/Run source, and a Run again action for the current working plan.
safeActions: Save current plan as a Version

states.label: HISTORICAL
states.definition: The user deliberately opened a persisted Run or Report. Its source remains distinct from the current workspace. A retained Report generated directly from a plan may have no Run; display No Run rather than treating its source as missing.
states.colorIndependentCue: Visible HISTORICAL text, source Scenario/Version/Run/date, and current workspace summary when different.
safeActions: Run again from this Run when its exact input is retained

states.label: UNAVAILABLE
states.definition: A legitimate result, detail, input, dataset, or artifact is not retained or cannot currently be loaded.
states.colorIndependentCue: Visible UNAVAILABLE text, a concrete reason, and an explicit next safe action when one exists.
safeActions: Enable rerun only when dataset and exact request are available

states.label: UNSUPPORTED
states.definition: The selected profile intentionally has no defined implementation for the requested quantity or feature.
states.colorIndependentCue: Visible UNSUPPORTED text and the model/profile reason.
safeActions: Inspect a separate research/reference output if available

states.label: RUNNING
states.definition: Optional execution activity wording; existing operation-specific progress labels remain authoritative.
states.userHeading: Simulating, Optimizing, Evaluating, or another exact operation label
states.colorIndependentCue: Visible operation text and busy state.

states.label: Research / reference
states.definition: An isolated research or reference analysis that is not canonical planning output.
states.colorIndependentCue: Visible text on the tool or result.

precedence: UNSUPPORTED applies to a specific feature or quantity; it does not change the freshness of the underlying Run.
UNAVAILABLE applies when bytes, detail, exact input, or required dataset cannot be loaded; preserve known historical source identity beside it.
HISTORICAL describes deliberate inspection of a persisted record and remains separate from the active workspace plan/result.
STALE describes a retained known Run that no longer matches the current effective plan.
CURRENT describes a matching successful Run only when evidence is comparable.
Do not infer freshness from timestamps. Unknown identity or missing fingerprints do not prove equality.
separateAxes: Draft persistence state: Saved Version / Unsaved changes.
Result freshness/inspection state: CURRENT / STALE / HISTORICAL / UNAVAILABLE / UNSUPPORTED.
Optimization role: Baseline / Optimized / Recommended / Selected / Pareto.
Evidence class: canonical planning output / Research / reference.
